text: In February at Bramford Academy, a Catholic boarding school in upstate New York, two girls are left behind for the break: Rose, a senior who fears she is pregnant, and Kat, a freshman who dreams that [her parents die in a car crash|trigger|losing family]. Kat answers to [a gravelly voice on the phone|threat|being taken over] and is found bowing again and again before [the boiler|images|household objects and machines]. Elsewhere, a young woman calling herself Joan escapes a mental institution and accepts a ride from [an older couple mourning their daughter|who_suffers|the grieving].
